title_en: Blood on the Shelves: Image Comics Reveals Vampire on Aisle 6, a Darkly Funny New Series Reimagining Horror in the Most Unexpected Setting
summary_en: What happens when a fledgling vampire becomes locked in a grocery store? Find out in the quirky new horror series Vampire on Aisle 6.
body_en:
IGN can exclusively reveal the latest series from Image Comics, a quirky and downright trippy vampire story dubbed Vampire on Aisle 6. And given that it's a collaboration between rising comics star Zoe Thorogood (It's Lonely at the Center of the Earth) and cartoonist/musician Joe Whiteford, it's a book that should definitely be on your radar.
Check out the slideshow gallery below for an exclusive preview of Vampire on Aisle 6 #1:
Vampire on Aisle 6 is a miniseries written by Thorogood and illustrated by Whiteford. Whiteford is also developing a companion EP album that will release alongside the comic. Here's the official description from Image Comics:
"Vampire on Aisle 6 is a comic + album about a self-proclaimed vampire trapped in a mascot-themed grocery store," Thorogood tells IGN. "It’s a story about traumatic change and the isolation that follows. We hope readers/listeners are ready for an unconventional vampire story and understand, that really, It’s All Just Meat."
Vampire on Aisle 6 #1 will be released on December 23. You can preorder a copy at your local ocmic shop .
For more, check out our exclusive interview about the upcoming finale of Star Trek: The Last Starship and see a bleak preview of The Amazing Spider-Man #1000 .
